claims.prior_claim: The v1.1 recovery overlay enhances bottom detection.
claims.validated_statement: The overlay adds trades and capital but does not improve episode hit rates; weighted distance is slightly worse for SPY, QQQ and SOXX.

claims.prior_claim: The monitor is a close-to-bottom detector.
claims.validated_statement: It is primarily a staged drawdown-participation model; QQQ and SOXX enter materially before the eventual trough in recent episodes.

claims.prior_claim: Aggregate results adequately describe model quality.
claims.validated_statement: Aggregate results conceal severe deterioration in episodes whose final drawdown exceeds 25%.

claims.prior_claim: Positive forward returns validate bottom timing.
claims.validated_statement: Forward returns are secondary economic outcomes and do not establish proximity to the eventual trough.
claims.evidence: metric-definition audit and episode path results

claims.prior_claim: Breadth reversal can confirm a final bottom.
claims.validated_statement: Equal-weight and cross-sectional breadth describe rebound participation but failed as standalone bottom-completion triggers.

claims.prior_claim: Financial/funding stress normalisation can confirm the equity trough.
claims.validated_statement: Stress normalisation may occur during intermediate bear rallies; use it as context or a veto, not a standalone trigger.
v1.7 is invalid for promotion because breach age reset repeatedly; only v1.8 is admissible.

claims.prior_claim: Current-constituent semiconductor panels can support production.
claims.validated_statement: They are survivorship-biased research proxies and require historical point-in-time membership before promotion.
SMH remains informational only because paired rules did not show persistent incremental value.

claims.prior_claim: A local swing recovery can be called a cycle bottom.
claims.validated_statement: Participation, local recovery and cycle-bottom evidence must remain separate.

claims.prior_claim: Model-simulated deployment reflects actual user execution.
claims.validated_statement: Simulated deployment, actual confirmed position and current action are separate fields.

claims.prior_claim: SSO, QLD or USD can be activated from underlying rebound confirmation alone.
claims.validated_statement: Daily-reset product-level path backtests and independently validated leverage gates are still required.
claims.evidence: official product objectives, SEC compounding risk and incomplete product validation

claims.prior_claim: The best next step is another price indicator.
claims.validated_statement: The highest-priority experiment is deep-bear capital reservation followed by authorised point-in-time feature ablations.
